title: Effects of predictive genetic testing
summary: The study will investigate the effects of predictive genetic screening on the quality of life and lifestyle of patients who present for a check-up at the Robert Bosch Hospital. It is a purely observational examination, which has no influence on your treatment or diagnostic measures. The genetic testing is performed and discussed independently from this study.
conditions: Genetic risk testing for malignancies (e.g., Breast Cancer 1/2), cardiovascular diseases, coagulation (e.g., thrombophilia), storage disorders (e.g., hemochromatosis), cholesterol, glaucoma, and pharmacogenomic information

interventions.name: Patients who have undergone genetic risk screening and agreed to participate in the study will be tracked over several years by means of questionnaires on quality of life and effects on further treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Declaration of consent to participate in this study
- genetic testing performed
Exclusion criteria:
- current pregnancy
- Active cancer
